name: Silver Bolts doubles its bonus against Undead and Demons (#3342)
contract: Silver Bolts 804026 reads 'Damage dealt by Heartseeking Bolt, Shadowblast, and Damnation is increased by $s1%, doubled against Undead or Demons or enemies affected by Shadow Trap' with $s1 = 15 (Spell.dbc 2026-09-17). Effect 2 is a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE +15% on Damnation and Heartseeking Bolt. Effect 0 is a raw aura 112 record with the private selector 20014 and MiscValueB 36 (creature-type mask: Demon 1 << (3 - 1) = 4 plus Undead 1 << (6 - 1) = 32), class mask (0x10000, 0x800, 0x10), which nothing reads; native aura 168 honours the effect's class mask once the selector is in MiscValueB (Unit.cpp:9250, 11276, unchanged). Both factors multiply in MeleeDamageBonusDone (Heartseeking Bolt 805754 and Damnation 520062 are DmgClass 3), so Undead and Demons read 1.15 x 1.15 = 1.3225, inside 1.29..1.33 which also admits an exact 1.30 'doubled'; a non-Undead target reads 1.15. On main the Undead and Demon ratios equal the control's 1.15. Creature types come from data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql: 201 Brittlebones Skeleton type 6 (Undead), 49 Lesser Succubus type 3 (Demon), 36 Harvest Golem type 9 (Mechanical). Shadowblast is not asserted: its class mask sits only in effect 0, so it gets no base +15%, a separate open question. The Shadow Trap clause (#4715) checks victim->HasAura(681177), 'Shadow Trapped', the debuff Witch Hunter field entity 506250 casts (data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260908_07_witch_hunter_completion.sql; AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp). It is now honoured entirely in CoA code: witch_hunter_silver_bolts_shadow_trap (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp, UNITHOOK_MODIFY_SPELL_DAMAGE_TAKEN) finds the player's own converted Silver Bolts (804026) MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS aura effect, applies its own effect 2 percentage again when the victim carries 681177 and is not already Undead/Demon (reading the mask from that same aura effect, not a literal), so a Mechanical target under Shadow Trapped reads 1.29..1.33 without needing creature type and without double-counting an Undead-and-trapped target. Native Unit.cpp carries no CoA spell ID for this; 574149/574163's identical creature-type conversion is unaffected since the hook only matches aura id 804026. Asserted via the new melee_spell_damage_done_scripted metric (apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md), which adds UnitScript::ModifySpellDamageTaken on top of the existing deterministic melee_spell_damage_done calculation so the hook is observable without a real cast or its crit-roll sampling (the wall that blocked PR #5650).
